$comment: Supervised Fiducia lease renewal — independent JSON Schema authority. Peer of contracts/renewal/typespec/main.tsp; neither is generated from the other.

LogicalMilliseconds.description: Process-local monotonic milliseconds capped at JavaScript's exact integer boundary.

FencingToken.description: A full-width Fiducia fencing token that renewal must preserve exactly.

RenewalTtlMilliseconds.description: Lease TTL in milliseconds, capped at the largest duration every supported runtime can represent without overflow.

RenewalPolicy.description: When to renew relative to the locally observed lease TTL. Both fields must be positive and less than the active TTL; the active TTL is capped at 9223372036854 ms for cross-runtime duration safety.

RenewalGrantIdentity.description: Exact lease identity that a successful renewal must preserve. Once an authority deadline is present, each renewal must report a strictly greater one.

RenewalDecision.description: One scheduling decision. checkInMs is present only for wait; reason only for lost.

RenewalSnapshot.description: Observable supervisor state retained by runtime implementations.
